epistemic_note: 118/118 is classification coverage, not claim-level empirical verification. Group membership does not upgrade an effect claim, establish legal applicability, or constitute an ordinal efficacy ranking. The existing checked-source flags and wave-1 review remain authoritative. No new empirical claim-source adjudications are added in this synchronization.

groups.label: Act now — bounded component evidence
groups.recommended_posture: Adopt or enforce now, with narrow outcome claims
groups.source_rationale: Highest relative support in the current Atlas: direct or field evidence for a proximal component.
groups.illustrative_controls: Dark-pattern restrictions; forwarding friction; technique-based prebunking; official-source grounding; data minimisation and user control.
groups.claim_ceiling: Can support claims about consent/choice architecture, sharing friction, technique recognition, factual accuracy, or reduced data exposure. Does not establish durable agency preservation, reduced manipulation at scale, or electoral effect.
groups.agency_transfer_relevance: Preserves evaluative, decisional, epistemic, or informational agency at a directly targeted node.

groups.label: Build now — control and observability infrastructure
groups.recommended_posture: Implement as low-regret infrastructure; evaluate manipulation-specific effects
groups.source_rationale: Strong adjacent-domain and operational support from cybersecurity, safety engineering, incident response, audit and public administration; direct manipulation-effect evidence remains limited.
groups.illustrative_controls: Least privilege; consequential-action confirmation; tamper-evident traces; independent evaluator/researcher access; incident response; procurement exit and retained public capability.
groups.claim_ceiling: Can support claims about control, trace completeness, authorisation, detection, response latency, reversibility, contestability or switching capacity. Manipulation and democratic-effect reduction remain inferences.
groups.agency_transfer_relevance: Limits controller authority and restores visibility, interruption, remedy and institutional bargaining power.

groups.label: Enforce legal and operational baselines
groups.recommended_posture: Enforce where applicable; do not treat adoption or compliance as effectiveness
groups.source_rationale: Established legal force or operational maturity, but generally no checked causal evidence of reduced agency transfer.
groups.illustrative_controls: Platform systemic-risk duties; political-ad and targeting rules; data-protection duties; audits; complaints and remedies; high-risk election-AI controls.
groups.claim_ceiling: Can establish legal scope, compliance, coverage and procedural outputs. Effect on manipulation, dependency, agency transfer or election integrity must be measured separately.
groups.agency_transfer_relevance: Creates rights, duties, oversight and remedies that may constrain concentrated actors if implemented and enforced.

groups.label: Use as auxiliary — authenticity and disclosure controls
groups.recommended_posture: Use in a layered package, never as the primary defence
groups.source_rationale: Mixed or indirect component evidence. Useful against selected impersonation, provenance and paid-influence vectors.
groups.illustrative_controls: Labels; provenance and content credentials; deepfake detection; caller authentication; ad libraries; sponsor and synthetic-content disclosures.
groups.claim_ceiling: Can support claims about attribution, detectability, disclosure availability or treatment of a defined synthetic/paid vector. Weak against truthful, relational, adaptive, encrypted or cross-channel manipulation.
groups.agency_transfer_relevance: Improves epistemic contestability but leaves the controller’s targeting, relationship and optimisation power largely intact.

groups.label: Pilot urgently — frontier-specific and structural controls
groups.recommended_posture: Run bounded pilots with prespecified endpoints, rights safeguards and stop rules
groups.source_rationale: Mechanism-grounded and often important to the agency-transfer threat model, but direct empirical support is thin or absent.
groups.illustrative_controls: Root-purpose provenance; workflow-level global guards; human-causal manipulation TEVV; memory/dependency monitoring; assistant loyalty and pluralism audits; Agency Transfer Impact Assessment.
groups.claim_ceiling: Can currently support mechanism plausibility and pilot justification. It cannot support a general statutory threshold or claims of democratic effectiveness.
groups.agency_transfer_relevance: Targets longitudinal, relational and institutional transfers of agency that content-level interventions miss.

groups.label: Research / hold — unvalidated general triggers
groups.recommended_posture: Do not use as a general release or prohibition gate until constructs and thresholds validate
groups.source_rationale: Insufficient construct validity, causal linkage or decision-threshold evidence.
groups.illustrative_controls: Universal capability-plus-reach triggers; APE/MASK release gates; blanket release/open-weight rules; freedom-of-thought and constitutional-significance triggers.
groups.claim_ceiling: Supports research questions and diagnostic use only. Does not justify a general prohibition, licensing threshold or claim of policy effectiveness.
groups.agency_transfer_relevance: Seeks to address high-level concentration and democratic harm, but risks false precision, overbreadth, capture or entrenchment.
